name: Archi

identification.note: No exact site is known; Scripture places it as a border district between Bethel and Ataroth, on the Ephraim-Benjamin boundary.

related_people.name: Hushai
related_people.role: David's friend from this district, sent back to defeat Ahithophel's counsel in Absalom's court

description: A district on Ephraim's southern border, between Bethel and Ataroth (Joshua 16:2), giving David's loyal friend and counselor Hushai his epithet "the Archite" (2 Samuel 15:32).
